title: The rate of convergence of the mean length of the longest common subsequence
venue: Annals of Applied Probability, Vol. 4, No. 4
key_contribution: Proves rate of convergence E[LCS(n,n)]/n → γ₂ is O(n^{-1/3+ε}); foundational result on convergence speed

title: Large deviations-based upper bounds on the expected relative length of longest common subsequences
key_contribution: Large deviation method for upper bounds on γ; bound converges to exact value as control parameter → ∞

title: Longest common subsequences in binary sequences
key_contribution: Studies L(nz,n)/n as z varies; relates function z → γ(z) to the outstanding problem of computing γ₂

title: A Central Limit Theorem for the Length of the Longest Common Subsequence in Random Words
key_contribution: Establishes CLT for LCS under certain conditions; provides tools for statistical inference about γ₂
